summary: The active-learning force-label generator now takes ISMEAR/SIGMA from the authoritative final-energy policy, and images 02-06 were rebuilt and preflighted on the Fe(110) SIGMA=0.20 branch without submission.

payload.objective: Validate the returned nine-image AQCat25 path for Fe(110) C* + H* -> CH* + * and prepare compatibility-matched VASP force labels for active-learning calibration.
current_evidence: The root cause was a builder inheritance defect: active-learning labels reused the legacy final_static SIGMA=0.10 value instead of the current production occupation branch.
The builder now applies final_energy_policy.required_surface_incar after the legacy static base and records that source plus fe110_converged_toten_sigma0p20_v1 in every label request.
Images 02-06 were rebuilt from the same reviewed structure hashes with ISMEAR=1 and SIGMA=0.20 eV.
All five diagnostic-static preflights pass; each label remains a non-reportable static energy/force label.
The prior SIGMA=0.10 batch is preserved with an explicit DO_NOT_SUBMIT supersession marker.
No POTCAR was copied and no VASP execution gate or submission authorization exists.
payload.one_executable_step: After explicit user authorization for this exact hash-bound five-image batch, supply the approved POTCAR on sunboquan-codex, re-run final bound preflights and submit images 02-06 as one bounded VASP force-label batch.
payload.submission_boundary: The user authorized repairing the generator and rebuilding plus pre-submission review of image 02-06 only. No VASP upload, POTCAR copy, force-label submission, DIMER, frequency, restart, resubmission, or additional GPU job is authorized.
done_when: The active-learning builder obtains the occupation convention from the authoritative production parameter table.
The exact reviewed image 02-06 structures are rebuilt with ISMEAR=1 and SIGMA=0.20 eV and pass static preflight.
The incompatible SIGMA=0.10 batch is clearly marked as superseded and cannot be confused with the submission candidate.
